name: One Last Wish
source:
A father dies unexpectedly on the way back from work. However, before moving onto the afterlife, he is granted a final wish to resolve an unfinished promise he had made while he was alive.  

[From [url=https://choppa2.itch.io/one-last-wish]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位父亲在下班回来的路上意外去世。然而，在进入来世之前，他实现了最后的愿望，以解决他生前未完成的承诺。

[来自[url=https://choppa2.itch.io/one-last-wish]Itch.io[/url]]
